reference_image.prompt: Reference image for 3D modelling of ONE single object: a small cluster of exactly three smooth rounded boulders of different sizes (one large, one medium, one small) nestled tightly together and touching, forming one compact chunky shape. Stylized 3D CGI game-asset look, smooth slightly clay-like surfaces, bright saturated toy-like colours, chunky simple shapes. The stones are warm light grey with a few soft carved grooves. Thick, puffy, bright lime-green moss blobs sit draped over the tops of the boulders like soft cushions, clearly separate from the grey stone. Three-quarter view from slightly above. No grass, no ground, no base, no pebbles, no plants, no flowers. The whole cluster is in frame, centred, with margin all around. Plain pure white background, flat even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text. Family-friendly.
